2. `udevadm control --reload-rules` and `udevadm trigger` — standard post-install steps for packages that ship udev rules (to grant access to the `uinput` device).

Both functions then print configuration instructions in Vietnamese to guide the user through enabling the systemd template service (`fcitx5-lotus-server@.service`) and configuring Fcitx5. The `\$` in `sudo systemctl enable --now fcitx5-lotus-server@\$(whoami).service` is properly escaped to display the literal command to the user; it is not executed by the script.

No network requests, no data exfiltration, no obfuscated code, no downloads, and no operations outside the application's scope were found. All behavior is consistent with ordinary AUR packaging practices for an input method package.
